description_en: Binds devices to an image search instance in batches
description_zh: 调用该接口可用以图搜图实例批量绑定设备
name: BindPictureSearchAppWithDevices

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html查询
parameters.name: app_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

Enterprise Enterprise instance: This parameter is required. You can view the ID of your Enterprise Enterprise instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.
Public instance: This parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
公共实例：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of device IotIds. You can specify the IotId of a V series edge gateway or camera.

The IotId is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query the IotId.

You can specify up to 20 device IotIds in a single request
parameters.help_zh:
设备IotId列表。支持传入V系列边缘一体机或摄像机的IotId。

IotId是物联网平台为设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

单次最多可填写20个设备IotId
parameters.name: device_iot_ids
